title: Counted Out
summary: The night shift's chains hang in the Assay's cage store. Old Brannagh wants a cleric of yours to stand there and count them out, properly, as nobody did.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards' second floor, by the cage store: hold six waves.

ready: The count is said in the cage store. Go back to Old Brannagh.
done: Brannagh taught your clerics how to bring someone back in. She says it's just counting, the other way.
